# flutter_widgetz

**Tag**: flutter, widget, mobile, ui

## 简介

A set of Flutter widgets I use in various projects. Including date and checkbox inputs, bottom navigation bar, color picker, divider and more!

## 官网

- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mj12358/flutter-widgetz
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_widgetz
